title: 第38章 你相信光吗
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 一道影子从阴影里猛地窜出！快得像是凭空出现，又像是早就等在那儿的猎手。绑匪还没来得及回头，怀里的小男孩就“嗖”地一下被温栩栩（大圣附身版）抢走了。紧接着，温栩栩一脚踹在另一个绑匪的腰上。那一脚的力道……怎么说呢。那个一米八几、浑身横肉的男人，整个人像是被汽车撞了一样，“嘭”的一声飞出去三米远，后背重重砸在地上，还滚了两圈。标准的抛物线。温栩栩自已都看傻了。对方飞出去这么远，而自已脚上的毛绒拖鞋都没掉！而那个被抢走的孩子，此刻正稳稳当当地被温栩栩抱在怀里，毫发无伤。他甚至还没来得及哭，睁着大眼睛，一脸茫然地看着眼前这个姐姐——粉色凯蒂猫睡衣，头发跑得乱糟糟，脚上还踩着一双毛茸茸的兔耳朵拖鞋。但就是这个姐姐，刚才像一道闪电一样冲过来，一脚把那个坏蛋踹飞了三米远！小男孩的眼睛从茫然变成震惊，又从震惊变成了星星眼。他仰着小脸，盯着温栩栩，眼神里写满了几个大字：这姐姐，比奥特曼还帅！！！小男孩甚至忘了自已被绑着，也忘了嘴里还塞着布，努力发出“呜呜”的声音，像是在说：“姐姐收我当徒弟吧！”而此时，两个绑匪从震惊中回过神来。一个捂着腰躺在地上嗷嗷叫，另一个瞪大眼睛看着眼前这个抢孩子的“对手”。然后他愣住了。月光下，温栩栩那身打扮清清楚楚地暴露在两人面前——一件粉色卡通睡衣，脚上一双毛茸茸的兔耳朵拖鞋，头发因为刚才的狂奔有点凌乱。整个人看起来就像刚从被窝里爬出来下楼扔垃圾的普通住户。绑匪的表情肉眼可见地扭曲了一下。刚才那一脚，把同伙踹飞三米远的人……就是这个普通路人女孩？就这？？？绑匪低头看了一眼自已腰间的匕首，又抬头看了一眼温栩栩那身粉色卡通睡衣，脸上的表情精彩极了。他抽出了匕首，刀刃在月光下闪着冷光：“臭丫头，把孩子给我们！别多管闲事！”他往前逼了一步，试图用凶器制造压迫感。但不知道为什么，温栩栩的嘴角，微微弯了一下。大圣语气带着那种欠揍的玩味：“匕首？嘿嘿，这玩意儿俺老——”大圣猛地刹住。好险！差点把“俺老孙”三个字秃噜出来了，可不能在凡间掉马甲啊！大圣清了清嗓子，硬生生拐了个弯：“……老娘五百年前就不玩了！”温栩栩在心里疯狂憋笑。绑匪手指微微一动，在背后悄悄按下了手机——同伙就在附近，只要拖住这个疯女人几分钟，等其他人赶到，这孩子还是他们的！他握紧匕首，猛地朝温栩栩冲过来，刀刃直刺！“把孩子给我！”温栩栩瞳孔一缩。然后她就看见自已的右手往下一探——脚上那只毛茸茸的兔耳朵拖鞋，被一把薅了下来。下一秒。“啪！！”一声脆响。绑匪整个人僵在原地，手里的匕首“当啷”掉在地上。他捂着脸，表情像见了鬼。刚才那一下……是拖鞋打的？他还没反应过来，第二下已经到了。“啪！！！”另一边的脸。又是拖鞋。绑匪原地转了个圈，眼冒金星，腿一软，直接跪在地上。然后第三下。“啪！！！”正面，脑门。一米八几的壮汉，被一只毛茸茸的兔子拖鞋，活生生抽趴下了。绑匪倒在地上，脸上印着两个清晰的鞋印，一个在左脸，一个在右脸，额头中间还有一个，整整齐齐，跟盖章似的。温栩栩看着自已脚上仅剩的那只拖鞋，人都麻了。大圣这才慢悠悠地把另一只拖鞋穿回去，踩了踩，确认穿好了。温栩栩忽然悟了。她原本还纳闷——大圣从三楼翻下来的时候，又是飞檐走壁又是狂奔，居然还惦记着穿那双毛绒拖鞋。当时她还嫌这玩意儿碍事儿，多一道流程。现在她明白了：“大圣！我就说你刚才怎么非要穿拖鞋出门，原来你是留着当武器！”大圣的声音在脑海里响起，带着几分理所当然：“那倒不是。”温栩栩一愣：“啊？”“光脚踩地上多刺挠啊。”大圣的语气嫌弃得很，“你们小姑娘皮肤嫩，磕着碰着留疤怎么办？俺老孙糙惯了没事，你这脚掌得好好护着。”温栩栩闻言沉默了。低头看了看脚上那只刚抽完绑匪、现在乖乖穿在脚上的毛茸茸拖鞋。再抬头看了看地上那个被拖鞋抽晕过去的绑匪。温栩栩对大圣的崇拜之情已经达到巅峰！大圣居然还是个粗中有细的暖男呢！！！话音刚落——两辆面包车从路边的黑暗里猛地冲出来，一个急刹，横停在温栩栩面前。车门“哗啦”拉开。八九个穿着黑色T恤、手持钢管的壮汉跳下车，瞬间把温栩栩围了个严严实实。那个被拖鞋抽懵的绑匪这会儿终于缓过劲来，捂着脸从地上爬起来，指着温栩栩咬牙切齿：“就是她！快把她绑上车！”“这个女人，必须灭口！”八九根钢管齐刷刷指向温栩栩。月光下，金属泛着冷光。温栩栩心跳漏了一拍。然而下一秒，她忽然感觉自已的眼睛——亮了。不对，是大圣的眼睛亮了。那眼神，跟饿了三天的猫看见鱼一样。“铁棍子！！！”大圣的声音在脑海里炸开，兴奋得像个看见新玩具的孩子。温栩栩还没反应过来，她的身体已经动了。一步踏前，右手一伸，直接从最前面那个黑衣人手里——夺过了钢管。动作快得对方根本来不及反应，只觉得手里一空，再看时，那根钢管已经稳稳握在眼前这个粉色睡衣女生手里。大圣操控着温栩栩的身体，把钢管在手里转了个圈，掂了掂分量，语气里全是嫌弃又兴奋的复杂情绪：“小样，跟俺老娘玩棍子？”他抬起头，扫了一眼周围那八九根钢管，嘴角一歪：“祖师爷面前班门弄斧呢。”下一秒。温栩栩的身体动了。一根钢管在温栩栩手里像是活过来一样，翻飞、横扫、挑、点、劈——没有一招是多余的。第一个黑衣人应声倒地。第二个钢管脱手，捂着手腕惨叫。第三个被一棍扫在小腿上，直接跪了。第四个、第五个、第六个……温栩栩感觉自已像在看一场动作电影，而且是第一视角的。她的大圣代打，正在用她的身体表演什么叫“一棍在手，天下我有”。钢管与钢管碰撞的声音，噼里啪啦响成一片。不到五分钟。地上躺了一大半。就在这时，远处警笛声大作。三四辆警车呼啸而来，红蓝警灯在夜色里疯狂闪烁。车门猛地拉开，全副武装的警察冲下来——然后集体愣住了。
content_en: A shadow suddenly burst out from the shadows!It was as fast as appearing out of thin air, and like a hunter who had been waiting there for a long time.Before the kidnapper could turn around, the little boy in his arms was snatched away by Wen Xuxu (possessed by the Great Sage).Immediately afterwards, Wen Xuxu kicked the other kidnapper on the waist.The force of that kick...how should I put it?The man, who was about 1.8 meters tall and covered in flesh, looked like he had been hit by a car. He flew three meters away with a "bang", hit the ground hard on his back, and rolled twice.Standard parabola.Wen Xuxu himself was dumbfounded.The other party flew so far, but the plush slippers on his feet didn't even fall off!The kid who was snatched away was now being held securely in Wen Xuxu's arms, unscathed.Before he even had time to cry, he opened his eyes wide and stared blankly at the sister in front of him - pink Hello Kitty pajamas, with messy hair, and a pair of fluffy bunny ear slippers on his feet.But it was this sister who just rushed over like a bolt of lightning and kicked the bad guy three meters away!The little boy's eyes changed from blank to shocked, and then from shocked to starry-eyed.He raised his little face and stared at Wen Xuxu, with several big words written in his eyes: This sister is more handsome than Ultraman!!!The little boy even forgot that he was tied up and that there was a cloth stuffed in his mouth. He tried his best to make a "wuwu" sound, as if to say: "Sister, please accept me as your apprentice!" At this time, the two kidnappers recovered from the shock.One was lying on the ground clutching his waist and howling, while the other stared wide-eyed at the "rival" in front of him who was snatching the child.Then he froze.Under the moonlight, Wen Xuxu's attire was clearly exposed in front of the two of them - a pink cartoon pajamas, a pair of fluffy rabbit ear slippers on her feet, and her hair was a little messy from running around just now.The whole person looked like an ordinary resident who had just crawled out of bed and went downstairs to throw away the garbage.The kidnapper's expression was visibly distorted.The person who kicked his accomplice three meters away with that kick just now... was this ordinary passerby girl?That's it???The kidnapper lowered his head and glanced at the dagger at his waist, then raised his head at Wen Xuxu's pink cartoon pajamas, with a wonderful expression on his face.He pulled out the dagger, and the blade shone coldly in the moonlight: "You bitch, give us the child! Don't meddle in your own business!" He took a step forward, trying to create a sense of oppression with the murderous weapon.But for some reason, the corners of Wen Xuxu's mouth curved slightly.The Great Sage's tone sounded like he wanted to be beaten: "Dagger? Hehe, this thing is for me -" The Great Sage suddenly stopped.What a risk!I almost blurted out the words "I am old grandson", but I can't lose my vest in the mortal world!The Great Sage cleared his throat and turned around: "...I stopped playing five hundred years ago!" Wen Xuxu laughed crazily in her heart.The kidnapper moved his fingers slightly and quietly pressed the phone behind his back - his accomplices were nearby. As long as they held the crazy woman for a few minutes and waited for others to arrive, the child would still be theirs!He clenched the dagger and rushed towards Wen Xuxu, stabbing straight with the blade!"Give me the child!" Wen Xuxu's pupils shrank.Then she saw her right hand reaching down - the fluffy rabbit ear slippers on her feet were pulled off.The next second."Pop!!" There was a crisp sound.The kidnapper froze in place, and the dagger in his hand fell to the ground with a clang.He covered his face and looked like he had seen a ghost.That blow just now...was caused by slippers?Before he could react, the second blow had already arrived."Pop!!!" The face on the other side.Slippers again.The kidnapper spun around in a circle, eyes flashing with stars, his legs went weak, and he knelt directly on the ground.Then the third time."Crack!!!" Front, forehead.The strong man, who was about 1.8 meters tall, was thrown down alive by a fluffy rabbit slipper.The kidnapper fell to the ground, with two clear shoe prints on his face, one on the left side of his face, one on the right side of his face, and another in the middle of his forehead, which were neatly stamped, as if they were stamped.Wen Xuxu looked at the only slipper on her feet and felt numb.The Great Sage slowly put the other slipper back on, stepped on it, and made sure it was put on.Wen Xuxu suddenly realized.She was originally puzzled - when the Great Sage climbed down from the third floor, he was flying over the walls and running wildly, but he was still thinking about wearing those plush slippers.At that time, she thought this thing was in the way and added another process.Now she understood: "Great Sage! I just said why you had to wear slippers to go out just now. It turns out that you kept them as weapons!" The Great Sage's voice sounded in her mind, with a sense of matter-of-factness: "That's not true." Wen Xuxu was stunned: ""Huh?""It's so prickly when you step on the ground with your bare feet."The great sage said in a disgusted tone, "You girls have tender skin, what should you do if you get scars from bumps? I'm used to it, you have to take good care of your feet."Wen Xuxu was silent after hearing this.He looked down at the furry slippers on his feet that had just been beaten by the kidnapper and were now wearing them obediently.Then he looked up at the kidnapper on the ground who was knocked unconscious by the slippers.Wen Xuxu's admiration for the Great Sage has reached its peak!The great sage is actually a warm-hearted man who is both thick and thin!!!As soon as he finished speaking, two vans suddenly rushed out of the darkness on the roadside, braked suddenly, and stopped in front of Wen Xuxu.The car door opened with a clang.Eight or nine strong men wearing black T-shirts and holding steel pipes jumped out of the car and immediately surrounded Wen Xuxu.The kidnapper, who was stunned by the slippers, finally recovered. He covered his face and got up from the ground. He pointed at Wen Xuxu and gritted his teeth: "That's her! Hurry and tie her into the car!" "This woman must be silenced!" Eighty-nine steel pipes were pointed at Wen Xuxu.Under the moonlight, the metal glowed coldly.Wen Xuxu's heart skipped a beat.However, the next second, she suddenly felt her eyes light up.No, it was the Great Sage's eyes that lit up.The look in his eyes was like that of a cat that has been hungry for three days when it sees a fish."Iron stick!!!" The great sage's voice exploded in his mind, as excited as a child seeing a new toy.Before Wen Xuxu could react, her body had already moved.He stepped forward, stretched out his right hand, and grabbed the steel pipe directly from the hand of the man in black at the front.The movement was so fast that the other party had no time to react. He only felt that his hand was empty. When he looked again, the steel pipe was already firmly in the hand of the girl in pink pajamas in front of him.The Great Sage controlled Wen Xuxu's body, turned the steel pipe in a circle in his hand, and weighed it. His tone was full of mixed emotions of disgust and excitement: "Young man, are you playing with a stick with my mother?" He raised his head, glanced at the eight or nine steel pipes around him, and said with a crooked corner of his mouth: "Master, I'm just playing tricks in front of you." The next second.Wen Xuxu's body moved.A steel pipe seemed to come alive in Wen Xuxu's hands, flying, sweeping, picking, tapping, and splitting - no move was redundant.The first man in black fell to the ground.The second steel pipe fell away, covering his wrist and screaming.The third one was struck on the calf with a stick and fell to his knees.The fourth, fifth, sixth... Wen Xuxu felt like he was watching an action movie, and it was from a first-person perspective.Her big sundae is using her body to perform what is meant by "With a stick in hand, I have the world."The sound of steel pipes colliding with steel pipes made a crackling sound.Less than five minutes.Most of it was lying on the ground.Just then, police sirens blared in the distance.Three or four police cars roared over, their red and blue lights flashing crazily in the night.The car door swung open, heavily armed police officers rushed out - and there was a collective freeze.
